name: Heritage Foundation

summary.text: The Heritage Foundation was founded on February 16, 1973 by Paul Weyrich, Edwin Feulner and brewer Joseph Coors; its own Feulner timeline credits the founding to donors including Joseph Coors, Edward E. Noble and Richard M. Scaife. Under Frank J. Walton it adopted direct-mail fundraising and its annual income reached $1 million in 1976.

sources.title: Paul Weyrich: Father of a New Right

facts.claim: Heritage's own Feulner timeline credits the foundation's 1973 founding to donors including Joseph Coors, Edward E. Noble and Richard M. Scaife.
facts.quote: donors including Joseph Coors, Edward E. Noble, and Richard M. Scaife

facts.claim: Modern Age's profile of Weyrich says Heritage was founded on February 16, 1973 by Weyrich, Feulner and Coors as a conservative counterpart to the Brookings Institution; Weyrich was its first president.
facts.quote: The Heritage Foundation was founded on February 16, 1973 by Paul Weyrich, Edwin Feulner, and Joseph Coors

sources.title: Paul Weyrich: Father of a New Right

facts.claim: Under Frank J. Walton the foundation began direct-mail fundraising and its annual income grew to $1 million per year in 1976.
facts.quote: Heritage's annual income grew to $1 million per year in 1976

openQuestions: Coors's seed gift is usually put at $250,000 and Scaife's later giving at 'tens of millions,' but those figures appeared only in tertiary summaries; Heritage's own timeline names Coors, Noble and Scaife without amounts. Koch-family grants to Heritage were not found in opened sources. Joseph Coors and Richard Mellon Scaife are not seeded entities.
